reports.title: November 3, 2026 - Shopify announced today financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Shopify achieved 32% revenue growth (32% in constant currency) and a 22% free cash flow margin.

guidance.heading: 2026 Outlook
section: For the fourth quarter of 2026, we expect:
•Revenue to grow at a low-thirties percentage rate on a year-over-year basis;
•Gross profit dollars to grow at a high-twenties percentage rate on a year-over-year basis;
•Operating expenses as a percentage of revenue to be 29% to 30%;
•Free cash flow margin to be consistent with the fourth quarter of 2025.

desk.headline: Revenue up 32% to $3.74bn, slightly below estimates; adjusted EPS $0.49 beat; Q4 growth seen in low 30s%
results: Revenue grew 32% to $3.74bn, just short of analysts' $3.75–3.77bn range. Merchant solutions rose 35%, subscriptions 20%.
Merchants sold $119.1bn of goods on Shopify (GMV), up 29%.
Operating income rose 66% to $568m; net income was $462m, up from $264m, despite a $122m loss on investments.
Free cash flow was $816m, a 22% margin, up from 18%.
Shopify bought back $562m of its own shares in the quarter.

guidance.summary: For Q4 Shopify expects revenue growth in the low 30s% and gross profit growth in the high 20s%, with operating expenses at 29–30% of revenue and free cash flow margin similar to Q4 2025. It gives no full-year figures.

points: Management said it delivered what it promised: GMV grew around 30% for a sixth straight quarter.
Shopping through chatbots and digital assistants is early but growing fast: such traffic more than doubled and those orders roughly tripled.
International GMV grew 32% and business-to-business GMV 74%; lifetime in-store sales passed $200bn.
Gross margin held at 47.6%; spending on its Sidekick assistant weighed on subscription margins.
Q4 revenue growth is guided to the low 30s%, with a currency headwind of under one point.
